en: The whole claims matrix joined to the ledger and judged at the presented revision: the working tree by default, or the checked-out commit as committed, read from the ledger that commit holds. Per claim: the proof state, the sentence explaining how that state was derived, why when the state alone does not say, the execution behind it, the files that changed since it, and the command that produces it again. A run on a commit the presented revision does not contain is stale, a test that declined to run is not run, and a run the working ledger holds that the presented commit's does not can only withhold proven. The tallies count the whole matrix even when the answer is filtered, and the findings name every claim that declares a guarantee the evidence does not support. Kept per checkout state, never longer: the ledger is a file that changes outside this process, and an edit of it, of a test or of any tracked file, a new untracked file, a commit or a new ref is a new answer.

en: There are no accounts and no tokens on this surface, so a request is judged by where it came from (ADR 0126). Binding beyond loopback hands every reachable host the read surface and nothing else: a request from an address that is not loopback runs a capability only when the capability reads (<t1/>) or when its input is a signed message the handler verifies against the trust policy — the mesh's <t2/>, <t3/> and <t4/>. Every other route, and every MCP tool that changes something, answers that caller <t5/> (HTTP 403) before its handler runs, including <t6/>, which would otherwise run any capability. The decision is per request, not per session: an MCP session id is a name, not a proof. Reads are still served to the whole network, unencrypted; to write from another machine, reach the loopback server through an SSH tunnel (<t7/>), whose requests arrive from loopback.
cs: Na tomto povrchu nejsou žádné účty ani tokeny, takže požadavek se posuzuje podle toho, odkud přišel (ADR 0126). Navázání mimo loopback poskytne každému dosažitelnému hostiteli povrch pro čtení a nic víc: požadavek z adresy, která není loopback, spustí schopnost jen tehdy, když schopnost čte (<t1/>) nebo když je jejím vstupem podepsaná zpráva, kterou handler ověří proti politice důvěry — <t2/>, <t3/> a <t4/> meshe. Každá jiná trasa a každý nástroj MCP, který něco mění, odpoví volajícímu <t5/> (HTTP 403) dříve, než se spustí jeho handler, včetně <t6/>, který by jinak spustil libovolnou schopnost. Rozhodnutí se činí na každý požadavek, ne na relaci: id relace MCP je jméno, nikoli důkaz. Čtení se stále poskytuje celé síti, nešifrovaně; chcete-li zapisovat z jiného počítače, připojte se k loopback serveru přes SSH tunel (<t7/>), jehož požadavky přicházejí z loopbacku.
